basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I recently got into chess and am trying to improve my blitz skills. I work as a freelance graphic designer, mostly during the night. I'm single and enjoy late-night Reddit browsing, especially on weekends. I often get lost in conspiracy theories, tech deals, and battle royale games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, which I pursued through online courses and self-study. My interest in chess is more recent, driven by its strategic depth and the challenge it poses. I also dabble in PC building, having assembled my own gaming rig after countless hours of research.
